purpose: Connect each legal proposition used in a property answer to the exact authoritative provision, relevant judicial authority and official guidance without collapsing distinct levels of authority.

proposition_record.scope: what proposition does and does not establish

authority_rules: Primary legislation controls where the proposition is statutory.
Statutory instruments operate within their enabling legal framework.
Case law must be tied to the proposition actually decided or authoritatively reasoned.
Official guidance explains administration or procedure but does not silently become legislation.
Administrative practice must not be presented as the statutory rule unless the source establishes that effect.
CICAN explanations must preserve the meaning and limitations of the underlying authority.
hard_stops: Never cite a case without stating the proposition for which it is relied upon.
Never use guidance to override legislation.
Never state an administrative procedure as the substantive legal rule.
Never expand a judicial proposition beyond the issue actually decided.
If authority levels conflict or the controlling source is unresolved, mark LEGAL_AUTHORITY_UNRESOLVED.
